= 14-05-2025 =
<s>We're starting public Release Candidate testing for Arma 3 platform '''update 2.20''' today.</s> This test has concluded, thanks!

<s>Steam beta branch access code: ''Arma3Update220RC''</s>

<s>Download sizes: ~112 MB (client) / ~52 MB (server)</s>


Pseudo-changelog:
* Performance optimizations
* Steam Game Recording
* UH-80 / AH-99 stub wings
* Illumination flares
* Miscellaneous fixes and tweaks

=== 14-05-2025 ===
Notable changes:
* Added: Custom Arma 3 Steam Game Recording icons (documentation forthcoming)
* Fixed: Various "Old Man" script errors
* Fixed: PP Fisheye / DepthOfField did not work in CfgOpticsEffect

=== 21-05-2025 ===
Notable changes:
* Fixed: Glitches on new stub wing helicopters and their armaments
* Tweaked: Color consistency of Steam Game Recording icons

=== 28-05-2025 ===
Notable changes:
* Added: Translations for new 2.20 texts
* Fixed: Potential crash discovered while testing Support multiplayer scenarios
* Tweaked: Separated DAGR variant for MH-80 Ghost Hawk stub wing pylons (and removed auto-seek from default DAGR again)
* Tweaked: Added missing pylon mirroring option to AH-99 stub wing variant

=== 04-06-2025 ===
Notable changes:
* Fixed: mfdMaxUserValues config entry was loaded too late (after MFDs were already initialized with a maximum of 50) (thanks ''Ampersand'')
* Fixed: The cache locator in “Old Man” was not working (thanks ''Laid3acK'')
* Added: Option to the disableChannels mission and server parameter to disable map drawing and map marker placement from the UI per chat channel
* Fixed: MH-80 stub wing pylon presets were using the incorrect version of DAGR missiles (thanks ''drebin052'')
